plain_english: Three claps first, sounded, to clear obstacles; with thrice-muttered topknot-count water then sprinkled.
sanskrit_cite: tālatrayam purā dattvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye | śikhāsaṃkhyābhijaptena toyenābhyukṣayet tataḥ

plain_english: Flowers and all in order — liṅga or altar; with fourteen mutterings, a flower-seat made.
sanskrit_cite: puṣpādikaṃ kramāt sarvaṃ liṅgaṃ vā stha.ṅdilaṃ ca vā | caturdaśābhijaptena puṣpeṇāsanakalpanā

plain_english: There let the hero worship forthgoing, then the very seat again; casketed, let him begin the worship after.
sanskrit_cite: tatra sṛṣṭiṃ yajed vīraḥ punar evāsanaṃ tataḥ | sṛṣṭiṃ tu sampuṭīkṛtya paścād yajanam ārabhet

plain_english: Full of all realities, graced with every limb — let the fortunate worship the goddess, twenty-seven-muttered.
sanskrit_cite: sarvatattvasusampūrṇām sarvāvayavaśobhitām | yajed devīṃ mahābhāgā saptaviṃśatimantritām

plain_english: Then with fragrant flowers as able let him honor; with supreme devotion worship, and offer up himself.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sugandhipuṣpaiś ca yathāśaktyā samarcayet | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā svātmanaṃ ca nivedayet

plain_english: Thus the worship told — even in fire-rite this rule: who did the worship-rule, rightly remembering the seed, succeeds.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yajanam ākhyātam agnikārye 'py ayaṃ vidhiḥ | kṛtapūjāvidhiḥ samyak smaran bījam prasiddhyati

plain_english: Beginningless-endless seed, blossoming, gone mid-tithis — in the heart-lotus meditate the moon-ray, ever practise.
sanskrit_cite: ādyantarahitam bījaṃ vikasat tithimadhyagam | hṛtpadmāntargataṃ dhyāyet somāṃśuṃ nityam abhyasyet

plain_english: Which desires he desires, them quickly may he win; though unknowing, he goes to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.
sanskrit_cite: yān yān kāmayate kāmāṃs tān tāñ cchīghram avāpnuyāt | ajñaḥ pratyakṣatām eti sarvajñatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ

plain_english: Thus mantra-fruit got — this Rudrayāmala; from this practice: fruition and all-knowingness are won.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ mantraphalāvaptir ity etad rudrayāmalam | etad abhyāsataḥ siddhiḥ sarvajñatvam avāpyate
